title: PROPOSED Atlas flow step or branch card (FlowNode) illustrative design
description: Transcribed from docs/product-truth/mock-data/leafcutter/atlas-flows.mock.json entities.FlowNode.fields (v4, the Atlas Flow finder). One record is a step or branch as the finder indexes it and its card on a flow page shows it: the actor badge, the card's accessible name, the step address, the field keys it uses and produces, its input/output gaps and its acceptance-criteria chips. Every field mirrors the stored node; actor_label, card_label, href, the field keys and the chips are derived from it. No finder index, card view model or runtime validation exists yet; the derivation rules are stated in the dataset's invariants and are not expressed here.

order.description: integer | null — the step's 1-based order; null for a branch

text.description: string — the stored description, searched as text

actor_label.description: enum — the actor badge every step and branch card shows, and the Actor facet's option label

card_label.description: string — the accessible name of the focusable card that opens its drawer with Enter

uses.description: array — field keys <contract>.<pointer segments joined by '.'> its io_contracts consume

produces.description: array — field keys its io_contracts produce

io_gap.description: boolean — true when its io_contracts declare missing_bindings

ac_chips.description: array — the acceptance-criteria chips in its drawer; href opens that AC in the Atlas
